The Chinese characters for Aria

As a transliteration, Aria is usually written 阿丽亚 (Ā lì yà). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

阿
Ā
a prefix, hill
丽
lì
beautiful
亚
yà
Asia, second

Origin and meaning

Aria comes from Italian and means “air, a solo song”.

About the name Aria

A musical term for a solo song, now a top US girls' name.
